method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record and every official attachment. Downloaded and extracted originals, compared SHA-256 values and normalized extracted text, and rendered the signed enactment because it has no usable text layer.

attachments.title: R-22-38 original resolution packet
attachments.reason: The proposal packet combines an unenacted resolution, Mayor's memorandum, fiscal-impact analysis, and a March draft of the designation report. It is superseded by the separate final June report and signed enactment.

attachments.title: R-22-38 Exhibit B final designation report
attachments.reason: Different PDF bytes from the existing archive, but exact normalized extracted-text match across all 32,033 characters. It is the same final June 2022 report and is retained once as canonical.

attachments.title: R-22-38 enacted resolution
attachments.reason: Visually verified signed R-2022-060: Council adopted it 9-0 on August 1, 2022, and the Mayor approved it August 12. This statutory designation is distinct from the supporting report.

result: Retain the existing final designation report once and add the signed designation resolution as the distinct governing action. Do not retain the original mixed legislative packet.
